text: APPROVE. The extraction removes an `if` with `&&` inside the loop and also drops the `&&` from the second condition, so complexity falls well below 15. The short-circuit order, the `continue` and the `ExactOnly: true` argument are unchanged, so behaviour is preserved. The new private static helpers look build-safe, though I could only review the diff and did not compile it or check the parameter types against the surrounding code.
